title: The life of a pro-gamer
titleChinese: 职业游戏玩家的生活是什么样的？
paragraphs: From pixel representations of table tennis in the 1970s to modern day cinematic storytelling, video games have evolved a lot and become more immersive. But it’s not just the graphics and gameplay mechanics that have changed – it has also opened up a range of career options, including that of professional gamer.

When gaming first started, those who loved video games and wanted to make a career out of them often ended up as developers, testers or coders. While there were competitions, sometimes held worldwide, in which amateur gamers could win money or prizes, it wasn’t really considered a career path until the late 2000s, when live streaming really took off and gamers became celebrities.

With e-sports now an integral part of gaming, what does a professional gamer’s life look like? The key, according to many pro-gamers, is practice – the same with many sports. While choosing the best peripherals is important, such as the right controller or keyboard, most pro-gamers spend hours every day working out hacks to save time or improve their chances of winning. And it’s not just while playing games that they need to be active, but also in real life. Exercising and stretching is vital to avoid injuries to their backs and wrists and preventing eye fatigue from spending long hours staring at monitors by taking regular screen breaks.

But it’s not just the physical aspects that gamers need to be careful with. According to some experts, like Dr Phil Birch, while the physical demands of e-sports and traditional sports are very different, the psychological impacts can be similar: regulating emotions, dealing with pressure and big crowds, and overcoming injury are just some of the common factors.
So, while the life of a pro-gamer may sound fun with lots of button bashing, just remember that it takes a lot of discipline and hard work to do it full-time.

vocabulary.entry: pixel representation /ˈpɪksl ˌreprɪzenˈteɪʃn/ 像素呈现形式
vocabulary.example: The early game relied on simple pixel representation for its characters.
vocabulary.translation: 这款早期游戏的角色采用了简单的像素呈现形式。

vocabulary.entry: cinematic storytelling /ˌsɪnəˈmætɪk ˈstɔːritelɪŋ/ 电影式叙事
vocabulary.example: The game is praised for its immersive cinematic storytelling.
vocabulary.translation: 这款游戏因其沉浸式的电影式叙事而备受好评。

vocabulary.entry: immersive /ɪˈmɜːsɪv/ adj. 沉浸式的；身临其境的
vocabulary.example: Virtual reality technology creates a highly immersive experience.
vocabulary.translation: 虚拟现实技术能打造出极具沉浸感的体验。

vocabulary.entry: gameplay mechanic /ˈɡeɪmpleɪ mɪˈkænɪk/ 游戏玩法机制
vocabulary.example: The unique gameplay mechanic of this game makes it stand out.
vocabulary.translation: 这款游戏独特的玩法机制使其脱颖而出。

vocabulary.entry: professional gamer /prəˈfeʃənl ˈɡeɪmə/ 职业电竞选手
vocabulary.example: He turned from an amateur player into a professional gamer after years of training.
vocabulary.translation: 经过多年训练，他从一名业余玩家成为了职业电竞选手。

vocabulary.entry: coder /ˈkəʊdə/ n. 程序员；编码员
vocabulary.example: The coder spent months debugging the game's source code.
vocabulary.translation: 这位程序员花了数月时间调试游戏的源代码。

vocabulary.entry: amateur gamer /ˈæmətə ˈɡeɪmə/ 业余玩家
vocabulary.example: The tournament is open to both amateur gamers and professionals.
vocabulary.translation: 这场赛事对业余玩家和职业选手都开放。

vocabulary.entry: live streaming /laɪv ˈstriːmɪŋ/ 直播
vocabulary.example: Live streaming has transformed the way people watch e-sports matches.
vocabulary.translation: 直播改变了人们观看电竞赛事的方式。

vocabulary.entry: take off /teɪk ɒf/ （事业等）腾飞；突然成功
vocabulary.example: The e-sports industry really took off in the early 2010s.
vocabulary.translation: 电竞行业在21世纪10年代初真正迎来了腾飞。

vocabulary.entry: e-sports /ˈiː spɔːts/ n. 电子竞技
vocabulary.example: E-sports has been included in some international sports events.
vocabulary.translation: 电子竞技已经被纳入一些国际体育赛事中。

vocabulary.entry: integral /ˈɪntɪɡrəl/ adj. 不可或缺的；构成整体所必需的
vocabulary.example: Teamwork is an integral part of success in team-based e-sports.
vocabulary.translation: 团队协作在多人团队电竞项目中是成功不可或缺的一部分。

vocabulary.entry: peripheral /pəˈrɪfərəl/ n. 外设（如键盘、鼠标等）
vocabulary.example: A high-quality peripheral can improve a gamer's performance.
vocabulary.translation: 一款高品质的外设能够提升电竞选手的表现。

vocabulary.entry: controller /kənˈtrəʊlə/ n. （游戏）手柄
vocabulary.example: He prefers using a wireless controller for console games.
vocabulary.translation: 他玩主机游戏时更喜欢用无线手柄。

vocabulary.entry: hack /hæk/ n. 技巧；窍门
vocabulary.example: The pro-gamer shared some useful hacks for the new game mode.
vocabulary.translation: 这位职业选手分享了一些适用于新游戏模式的实用技巧。

vocabulary.entry: stretch /stretʃ/ v. 拉伸；伸展
vocabulary.example: Gamers should stretch their wrists regularly to prevent strain.
vocabulary.translation: 电竞选手应该定期拉伸手腕，避免肌肉劳损。

vocabulary.entry: vital /ˈvaɪtl/ adj. 极其重要的；必不可少的
vocabulary.example: Getting enough rest is vital for a pro-gamer's performance.
vocabulary.translation: 充足的休息对职业电竞选手的赛场表现至关重要。

vocabulary.entry: eye fatigue /aɪ fəˈtiːɡ/ 眼疲劳
vocabulary.example: Long hours of gaming can lead to eye fatigue and dry eyes.
vocabulary.translation: 长时间打游戏会导致眼疲劳和眼睛干涩。

vocabulary.entry: monitor /ˈmɒnɪtə/ n. 显示器
vocabulary.example: He bought a high-refresh-rate monitor for a smoother gaming experience.
vocabulary.translation: 他买了一台高刷新率显示器，以获得更流畅的游戏体验。

vocabulary.entry: screen break /skriːn breɪk/ 屏幕休息时间
vocabulary.example: Experts recommend taking a 10-minute screen break every hour.
vocabulary.translation: 专家建议每小时休息10分钟，远离电子屏幕。

vocabulary.entry: physical demand /ˈfɪzɪkl dɪˈmɑːnd/ 体能要求
vocabulary.example: The physical demand of e-sports is often underestimated by people.
vocabulary.translation: 电竞项目的体能要求常常被人们低估。

vocabulary.entry: psychological impact /ˌsaɪkəˈlɒdʒɪkl ˈɪmpækt/ 心理影响
vocabulary.example: The psychological impact of losing a major tournament can be huge.
vocabulary.translation: 输掉一场大型赛事带来的心理影响可能是巨大的。

vocabulary.entry: regulate emotion /ˈreɡjuleɪt ɪˈməʊʃn/ 调节情绪
vocabulary.example: Learning to regulate emotion is a key skill for pro-gamers.
vocabulary.translation: 学会调节情绪是职业电竞选手的一项核心技能。

vocabulary.entry: button bashing /ˈbʌtn ˈbæʃɪŋ/ （游戏中）疯狂按键
vocabulary.example: Button bashing alone won't help you win in strategy games.
vocabulary.translation: 在策略类游戏中，单靠疯狂按键是无法取胜的。

vocabulary.entry: discipline /ˈdɪsəplɪn/ n. 自律；自制力
vocabulary.example: A high level of discipline is required to be a full-time pro-gamer.
vocabulary.translation: 成为全职职业电竞选手需要具备极强的自律性。

vocabulary.entry: full-time /ˌfʊl ˈtaɪm/ adj. 全职的
vocabulary.example: He switched from a part-time to a full-time pro-gamer last year.
vocabulary.translation: 他去年从兼职职业电竞选手转为了全职选手。

sentences.english: From pixel representations of table tennis in the 1970s to modern day cinematic storytelling, video games have evolved a lot and become more immersive.
sentences.chinese: 从20世纪70年代以像素呈现的乒乓球游戏，到如今具有电影级叙事感的作品，电子游戏已经有了长足的发展，变得愈发沉浸式。

sentences.english: But it’s not just the graphics and gameplay mechanics that have changed – it has also opened up a range of career options, including that of professional gamer.
sentences.chinese: 但发生改变的不只是游戏画面和玩法机制——这个行业还拓展出了一系列职业选择，职业电竞选手便是其中之一。

sentences.english: When gaming first started, those who loved video games and wanted to make a career out of them often ended up as developers, testers or coders.
sentences.chinese: 在电子游戏发展初期，那些热爱游戏并想以此为业的人，大多最终成为了开发者、测试员或程序员。

sentences.english: While there were competitions, sometimes held worldwide, in which amateur gamers could win money or prizes, it wasn’t really considered a career path until the late 2000s, when live streaming really took off and gamers became celebrities.
sentences.chinese: 当时虽然也有一些赛事，有些甚至是全球性的，业余玩家可以在这些比赛中赢得奖金或奖品，但直到21世纪末直播行业真正兴起、电竞选手跻身名人之列后，电竞才被正式视为一条职业道路。

sentences.english: With e-sports now an integral part of gaming, what does a professional gamer’s life look like?
sentences.chinese: 如今电竞已经成为游戏行业不可或缺的一部分，那么职业电竞选手的日常生活是怎样的呢？

sentences.english: The key, according to many pro-gamers, is practice – the same with many sports.
sentences.chinese: 许多职业选手表示，成功的关键在于训练——这和许多传统体育项目是一样的。

sentences.english: While choosing the best peripherals is important, such as the right controller or keyboard, most pro-gamers spend hours every day working out hacks to save time or improve their chances of winning.
sentences.chinese: 挑选合适的外设固然重要，比如趁手的手柄或键盘，但大多数职业选手每天都会花费数小时钻研技巧，以此节省操作时间或提高获胜概率。

sentences.english: And it’s not just while playing games that they need to be active, but also in real life.
sentences.chinese: 而且他们不仅需要在游戏中保持良好状态，在现实生活中也是如此。

sentences.english: Exercising and stretching is vital to avoid injuries to their backs and wrists and preventing eye fatigue from spending long hours staring at monitors by taking regular screen breaks.
sentences.chinese: 规律锻炼和拉伸至关重要，能有效避免腰背和手腕受伤；同时，长时间盯着显示器容易造成眼疲劳，因此定期休息也必不可少。

sentences.english: But it’s not just the physical aspects that gamers need to be careful with.
sentences.chinese: 但选手们需要注意的不只是身体层面的问题。

sentences.english: According to some experts, like Dr Phil Birch, while the physical demands of e-sports and traditional sports are very different, the psychological impacts can be similar: regulating emotions, dealing with pressure and big crowds, and overcoming injury are just some of the common factors.
sentences.chinese: 菲尔·伯奇博士等专家表示，尽管电竞和传统体育对选手的体能要求大不相同，但二者带来的心理影响却有相似之处：情绪调节、应对压力和观赛的大批观众、克服伤病困扰，这些都是二者共通的挑战。

sentences.english: So, while the life of a pro-gamer may sound fun with lots of button bashing, just remember that it takes a lot of discipline and hard work to do it full-time.
sentences.chinese: 因此，尽管职业电竞选手的生活听起来似乎充满乐趣，只需整日敲击按钮，但请记住，想要全职从事这份职业，需要极强的自律和不懈的努力。
